At the start of each month your salary arrives and living costs are deducted. Sometimes an event needs your decision.

When you're done, tap "Next Month". The market moves and your monthly report appears.

en:
Choose food and housing. Cheap options grow savings faster but can lower health and happiness.

Build an emergency fund (3-6x monthly spending) for sickness, layoffs, or repairs.

At first only savings, deposits, and money market funds are open. Equity funds, stocks, then crypto unlock as you meet requirements.

Remember: higher potential return means higher risk.
